text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The government decided to restructure the National Oil Company holding.
- Azomures SA fertiliser maker, listed on the first tier of the Bucharest bourse, is allegedly confronted with financial problems, the paper says.
- Hungarian businessmen are interested to invest in Romania, the paper says.
- The price for natural gas was set at 230 lei per cubic metre.
- The state Tarom SA airline has allegedly suspended plans to buy eight Boeing 737s, the paper says.
- Tarom decided to cut fares on its flights to New York.
- The government plans to seek parliamentary support to reaffirm its commitment to tough economic reform.
